analysis.insight_summary: Participants discuss limitations in multiplying two analog inputs directly in [product_name], with functionality varying by device version. Newer modules support the feature in the software, while older devices require external circuits or workarounds. This highlights how version differences impact the ability to perform basic automation tasks efficiently.
